decisions.reason: This looks more like a successful upgrade and relaunch of an already accepted machine, so performance is likely above aspiration and there is little reason to withdraw it quickly.

Because it was only mentioned rather than prominently featured, its market reception is more uncertain, but the firm would likely keep it for another year while learning before reallocating resources.

The stationary electric fine shredder appears to be a more experimental niche offering, so its shortfall risk is higher, yet organizational slack and the need to test demand make immediate withdrawal less likely than retention.
As a targeted variant for green waste within the firm’s mobile grinder business, it likely benefits from related capabilities and would typically be retained while sales evidence accumulates.

Its own product page suggests strategic importance and stronger internal support, so a long-established machinery producer would usually continue this line unless results fell clearly below aspiration.
